content: Build a persistent personal context layer ("Alankrit OS") for future AI systems.
detail: Decider: ALANKRIT. Context: work spread across many projects and AI sessions. Problem: a new AI "which has never seen this project before" lacks his reasoning (S-v1). Alternatives: —. Chosen: extract context per project and hand it off to "Alankrit OS". Rationale (EXPLICIT, S-v1): "What context from this project should persist into my future AI systems." Tradeoffs: heavy agent time per project. Result: pipeline exists. Reversed: no. Status: ACTIVE. Confidence: HIGH. Sources: S-v1 intro, §20.

content: Use one universal, project-agnostic protocol, run by an agent inside each project, with read-only access.
source: S-v1 "Do not modify project files"; X-icarus manifest
detail: Decider: ALANKRIT. Alternatives: —. Rationale (INFERRED, MEDIUM): repeatable across ~40 home folders (H). Risks accepted: extraction quality depends on what the agent reads (the Icarus run read 0 session transcripts). Result: Icarus extraction. Status: ACTIVE (protocol revised to v2, D10). Sources: S-v1 "Do not modify project files"; X-icarus manifest.

content: Epistemic labelling is mandatory: FACT / EXPLICIT_BELIEF / INFERRED_BELIEF / DECISION / HYPOTHESIS / UNKNOWN, plus HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW reliability.
status: ACTIVE; extended in S-comp (status vocabulary) and S-v2 (author labels)
detail: Decider: ALANKRIT. Rationale (EXPLICIT, S-v1 §4): "NEVER present an inference as a fact." Status: ACTIVE; extended in S-comp (status vocabulary) and S-v2 (author labels). Sources: S-v1 §4, §17.

content: Two-stage architecture: per-project extractions feed a separate compiler workspace that treats the corpus as read-only.
status: ACTIVE, with the role refined by D10 (C01)
detail: Decider: ALANKRIT. Rationale (EXPLICIT, S-comp): "The path above is the SOURCE CORPUS"; outputs go to the workspace. Tradeoff: two places to keep in sync. Status: ACTIVE, with the role refined by D10 (C01). Sources: S-comp preamble, Phase 22.

content: The eventual consumer is an autonomous multi-agent personal-brand system.
status: STATED INTENT; the system itself is not evidenced (O02)
detail: Decider: ALANKRIT. Status: STATED INTENT; the system itself is not evidenced (O02). Confidence: HIGH that it was stated, LOW on its state. Source: S-comp preamble.

content: Optimization order: fidelity > completeness > provenance > elegance > brevity. Never invent, never silently resolve contradictions, never overwrite history with the latest statement.
status: ACTIVE; carried into S-v2's CRITICAL RULES
detail: Decider: ALANKRIT. Status: ACTIVE; carried into S-v2's CRITICAL RULES. Source: S-comp Final Quality Test.

content: Require machine-readable memory (JSONL), a knowledge graph, a reproducible local compiler (`python compiler/run.py`), and a validation report.
detail: Decider: ALANKRIT. Rationale (INFERRED, MEDIUM): agents need queryable memory and a reproducible build. Result: built (E07). Status: ACTIVE. Source: S-comp Phases 18, 19, 22, 23.

content: Compiler design: deterministic line-anchored parsers + a hand-curated overlay (`compiler/curated.py`) + authored narrative docs whose `[project:ID]` refs and quotes are checked by a validator.
detail: Decider: ASSISTANT. Alternatives considered (by the assistant): fully model-generated prose (rejected: unverifiable); fully deterministic (rejected: belief statuses and transitions need judgment). Tradeoffs: the overlay is manual and Icarus-specific, so it won't scale to many projects without per-project overlays. Result: 18 PASS / 2 WARN. Reviewed by Alankrit: **no record**. Status: ACTIVE. Sources: W `compiler/*.py`, `16_VALIDATION_REPORT.md`.

content: Do not claim cross-project patterns; label every "recurring" pattern as cross-domain within one project.
detail: Decider: ASSISTANT. Rationale: the corpus held one project. Status: ACTIVE until recompile. Source: W `03_GLOBAL_DECISION_REGISTER.md` § Recurring decision patterns.

content: Protocol v2: per-project slug folders; archive before material overwrite; author labels; a 7-level source-priority ranking; new file set (adds belief evolution, Alankrit context and failures.jsonl; drops the glossary).
detail: Decider: ALANKRIT. Rationale (INFERRED, MEDIUM-HIGH): it fixes what the v0 compile exposed (see BT01–BT04). The slug examples in S-v2 (signal, tempo, pantheon, solar-forecasting, job-application-context) match the projects the compiler named as missing. Status: ACTIVE. Source: S-v2.

Decider: ALANKRIT (selection). Alternatives (offered by the assistant): extract a different project folder; re-home Icarus only. Chosen despite the stated warning that the result "would be mostly circular". Rationale: not stated. `HYPOTHESIS`: he wants every node, including the pipeline itself, captured as a project. Status: executed (this folder). Source: S-ans.

content: Move the flat Icarus extraction into `icarus/`, archiving the original.
detail: Decider: ALANKRIT (picked the recommended option). Status: done (D13). Source: S-ans.

content: Execute the move as copy → sha256 verify → delete, with an ARCHIVE_NOTE explaining that the archive is for layout, not staleness.
detail: Decider: ASSISTANT. Note: the first attempt failed silently and was caught (F07). Status: done. Source: archive folder.

content: Tag every workspace-derived claim about Alankrit as `DERIVED_FROM_ICARUS`, and keep his authorship of protocol text `UNKNOWN`.
detail: Decider: ASSISTANT, under S-v2 Step 9 and Rule 8. Rationale: avoid double-counting in a global compile, and avoid attributing possibly AI-drafted prompts to him. Status: ACTIVE. Source: this folder's `memory/`.
